内容提要
这本连环画是根据《西游记》第五十九回——六十一回编绘的。
孙悟空跟随师父去西天取经，一路经历了千辛万苦。一日，又遇见火焰山阻路，唐僧十分烦恼。孙悟空打听出铁扇公主的芭蕉扇能够扇熄火焰，就去找铁扇公主借用芭蕉扇。谁知铁扇公主记起前仇，不但不借，反而将悟空扇出九霄云外。悟空正在左右为难，巧遇灵吉菩萨赠给他避风丹，悟空有了宝丹，又经过好多曲折，才将芭蕉扇取走，悟空扇熄火焰，除掉当地大害，师徒顺利通过火焰山，直奔西天而去。
这个故事生动、曲折，刻画了孙悟空机智、勇敢，不怕困难的斗争精神。
1 唐僧率领悟空、八戒、沙僧，过山越水，往西天取经。行走之间，渐觉热气蒸人，唐僧勒住马问：“如今正是秋天，为何这般酷热？”八戒正不想去西天，就借口说：“想必到日落之处了，再往前走，要把人热死！”
page_text_en:
Content Summary
This illustrated storybook is adapted from Chapters 59 to 61 of Journey to the West.
Sun Wukong follows his master on a journey to the West to obtain scriptures, enduring countless hardships along the way. One day, they encounter the Flaming Mountains blocking their path, causing Master Tang great distress. Sun Wukong learns that Princess Iron Fan’s Banana Leaf Fan can extinguish the flames, so he goes to borrow it. However, Princess Iron Fan recalls their past grudge, refuses to lend it, and instead fans Sun Wukong out into the nine heavens. Just as Sun Wukong is at a loss, he meets the Bodhisattva Lingji, who gives him the Wind-Repelling Pill. With the pill, and after many twists and turns, Sun Wukong finally obtains the Banana Leaf Fan, extinguishes the flames, eliminates the local disaster, and the master and disciples pass through the Flaming Mountains smoothly, heading straight for the West.
This story is vivid and full of twists, portraying Sun Wukong’s intelligent, brave, and fearless spirit in overcoming difficulties.
1. Master Tang leads Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing, crossing mountains and rivers on their journey to the West. As they walk, they begin to feel the intense heat. Master Tang stops his horse and asks, “It’s autumn now, why is it so hot?” Zhu Bajie, who doesn’t want to go to the West, excuses himself by saying, “We must be approaching the place where the sun sets. If we go any further, we’ll be roasted to death!”
summary_zh: 本页为绘本《三盗芭蕉扇》的内容提要，概述了孙悟空为借芭蕉扇、熄灭火焰山火焰而经历的曲折过程，并展示了师徒四人行至火焰山、八戒抱怨酷热的首个画面及对话。

2 悟空上前拉住八戒说：‘呆子不要胡说。像你这样磨磨蹭蹭，只怕走一辈子也走不到西天！’八戒说：‘那为何这般酷热？’沙僧说：‘想是天时不正，秋行夏令吧！’
3 三个正在争论，只见那边有座庄院，唐僧下马说：‘悟空，你去那家问问，这是什么缘故？’八戒也答腔说：‘顺便给我带些水喝，再不喝水，就把我渴死了！’
page_text_en:
2 Wukong stepped forward and grabbed Bajie, saying, 'Fool, don't talk nonsense. If you keep dawdling like this, we might never reach the West!' Bajie replied, 'Then why is it so unbearably hot?' Sha Wujing said, 'Perhaps the seasons are out of order, autumn acting like summer!'
3 While the three were arguing, they saw a farmhouse in the distance. Tang Sanzang dismounted and said, 'Wukong, go ask them what's going on.' Bajie chimed in, 'And bring me some water too! If I don't drink soon, I'll die of thirst!'
summary_zh: 师徒四人行至火焰山，因酷热而争论。悟空劝八戒不要磨蹭，沙僧认为是天时反常，唐僧让悟空去打听缘由，八戒则请求顺便带水解渴。

4 悟空到了庄院，敲了两下门，里面出来一位老人。老人吃惊地说：“你是哪里的怪人，敲门何事？”悟空说：“我是大唐三藏国师弟子齐天大圣孙悟空，我们师徒四人往西天取经，走到这里，天气大变，不知何故，特来相问。
5 老人连忙说：“我老眼昏花，不识尊颜，还请原谅。”接着又说：“你师傅现在哪里，快请来一坐。”悟空说：“就在那边休息。”说着连连向唐僧他们招手。
page_text_en:
4 Wukong arrived at the farmhouse, knocked on the door twice, and an old man came out. The old man was surprised and said, “Who are you, strange person? What do you want?” Wukong replied, “I am Sun Wukong, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, disciple of Master Tang from the Tang Dynasty, and we four disciples are traveling west to fetch scriptures. We’ve come here and the weather has suddenly changed. I don’t know why, so I’ve come to ask.
5 The old man hurriedly said, “My eyes are dim with age, I didn’t recognize your noble presence. Please forgive me.” He then added, “Where is your master? Please bring him over to sit.” Wukong said, “He’s resting over there.” Saying this, he waved repeatedly toward Master Tang and the others.
summary_zh: 孙悟空来到一户庄院，敲门向一位老人打听天气突变的原因，老人认出他是齐天大圣后，连忙道歉并邀请他师傅过来休息。

6 唐僧同八戒、沙僧牵马挑担走来。老人连忙把他们让到院里，端茶招待。唐僧问：‘这里秋天，为何还这样热？’老人说：‘这里叫火焰山，无春无秋，四季常热。’
7 唐僧吃惊地说：‘这样说，我们就无法过去了？’老人道：‘那火焰山离这六十里，正是西行必经之路，周围八百里全是火焰，就是钢头铁臂也要化成汁水。’唐僧听了，十分发愁。
page_text_en:
6 Tang Sanzang, accompanied by Zhu Bajie and Sha Wujing, arrived, leading the horse and carrying the luggage. The old man hurriedly welcomed them into the courtyard and served them tea. Tang Sanzang asked, 'It's autumn here, why is it still so hot?' The old man replied, 'This is called Flame Mountain; there is no spring or autumn, it's hot all year round.'
7 Tang Sanzang exclaimed, 'If that's the case, we won't be able to pass through?' The old man said, 'Flame Mountain is sixty li away, exactly on the path of our westward journey. For eight hundred li around, it's all flames; even steel heads and iron arms would melt into juice.' Tang Sanzang, upon hearing this, became very worried.
summary_zh: 唐僧师徒来到一户人家，老人告知他们此地为火焰山，四季炎热，且前方火焰山方圆八百里皆为烈焰，难以通行，唐僧听后十分发愁。

8 这时，门外走来个人，推一辆车子，叫喊卖糕。悟空出来买了一块糕，拿在手中，跟火炭一样热，忙说：‘这样热怎么吃？’那人道：‘不冷不热，五谷不结，哪有糕吃？’
9 悟空说：‘这样热也能生五谷么？’那人道：‘这里有个铁扇公主，她有一把千斤重的芭蕉扇，求得她来，一搧生风，二搧下雨，三搧灭火，自然就能种庄稼。’悟空听了，喜欢得跳了起来。
page_text_en:
8 At this moment, someone came from outside, pushing a cart and shouting to sell cakes. Wukong came out and bought a cake, holding it in his hand, which was as hot as charcoal. He hurriedly said, 'How can I eat this when it's so hot?' The man replied, 'If it's neither cold nor hot, crops won't grow—how could there be any cakes to eat?'
9 Wukong asked, 'Can crops even grow in such heat?' The man replied, 'There is a Princess Iron Fan here. She has a banana leaf fan weighing a thousand jin. If we can get her to come, one wave will create wind, two waves will bring rain, and three waves will extinguish the fire. Then we can naturally grow crops.' Wukong, upon hearing this, jumped for joy.
summary_zh: 孙悟空在庄院外买糕时发现糕热如炭，向卖糕人询问原因，得知此处有铁扇公主和能灭火的芭蕉扇，他听后欣喜若狂。

10 悟空回到院内，把芭蕉扇之事告诉师父，老人说：
“请铁扇公主，需有礼物，不然，怕请不来。”悟空说：“你说她住哪里，我自有办法。”
11 老人说：“对你说也无用，她住在这西南方向，翠云山的芭蕉洞，离这约有一千多里，我看你几时能到？”悟空笑着说：“不远！不远！”一个筋斗翻上天空。
page_text_en:
10 Wukong returned to the courtyard and told his master about the banana fan. The old man said: 
"To invite Princess Iron Fan, you need a gift; otherwise, she may not come." Wukong replied: "Tell me where she lives, and I'll have my own way." 
11 The old man said: "Even if I tell you, it won't help. She lives to the southwest, in the Banana Cave of Mount Cuicun, over a thousand li away. I wonder when you'll get there?" Wukong laughed and said: "Not far! Not far!" He flipped a somersault into the sky.
summary_zh: 孙悟空向师父和老人打听铁扇公主的住处，得知她住在翠云山的芭蕉洞，距离遥远，但孙悟空自信地翻筋斗飞向目的地。

12 悟空霎时到了翠云山，正在空中向下找芭蕉洞，忽然听到叮叮响声，仔细一看，原来是一个樵夫在砍柴。
13 悟空下来向他施礼，说：‘大哥，你可知道芭蕉洞在哪里？’樵夫用手一指说：‘就在那边不远，洞前一片蕉林。’
page_text_en:
12 Wukong arrived at Cuiyun Mountain in an instant, searching for the Banana Cave from the air. Suddenly, he heard a tapping sound. Looking closely, he saw a woodcutter chopping firewood.
13 Wukong landed and bowed to him, saying: 'Brother, do you know where the Banana Cave is?' The woodcutter pointed and said: 'It's not far from here, with a banana grove in front of the cave.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空飞到翠云山寻找芭蕉洞，途中遇到一位砍柴的樵夫，向他打听洞穴位置，樵夫指引说就在不远处的蕉林前。

14 悟空到了芭蕉洞口，上前敲门，小女童开门问：‘叫门何事？’悟空说：‘我是大唐国师大徒弟齐天大圣孙悟空，为过火焰山，特来借扇，烦你向公主通禀一声。’
15 女童进去向铁扇公主一说，公主如同火上烧油，恶狠狠地说：‘前时他坑害了我的孩子，我正要找他报仇，快把那两口青锋宝剑给我，杀死这个泼猴！’
page_text_en:
14 Wukong arrived at the entrance of the Banana Cave, knocked on the door. A young girl opened it and asked, 'What do you want?' Wukong replied, 'I am Sun Wukong, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, the eldest disciple of the Tang Monk. I have come to borrow the fan to pass through the Flame Mountain. Please inform the princess for me.'
15 The girl went inside to tell Princess Iron Fan. The princess, like oil on fire, growled angrily, 'He once harmed my child. I was just about to seek revenge. Quickly bring me those two sharp swords and kill this rascal!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空抵达芭蕉洞口，向小女童说明来意借扇，女童通报后，铁扇公主因孙悟空曾伤害其子而怒不可遏，命令取剑杀之。

16 公主怒冲冲地提了双剑出来说：‘你这泼猴，为何害我孩子红孩儿。’悟空陪笑说：‘你儿子捉了我师父，要蒸要煮，幸亏观音菩萨收了他去，修成正果，你不感谢我老孙，还要辱骂我吗？’
17 公主说：‘你不要巧嘴，我儿虽未伤命，一辈子也见不到了。’行者说：‘不难！只要你把扇子借我，熄火以后，就到南海菩萨处请他回来与你团聚。’公主说：‘不要饶舌，伸过头来，能吃住我砍几剑，我就借你！’
page_text_en:
16 The princess angrily drew her twin swords and said, 'You rascal monkey, why did you harm my son, Red Boy?' Wukong smiled and replied, 'Your son captured my master, intending to steam and boil him. Fortunately, Guanyin Bodhisattva took him in and helped him achieve enlightenment. Shouldn't you be thanking me, instead of insulting me?'
17 The princess said, 'Don't talk so cleverly. My son may not be dead, but I'll never see him again.' The pilgrim said, 'It's not difficult! Just lend me your fan to put out the fire, and after that, I'll go to the South Sea Bodhisattva to bring him back for you to reunite.' The princess said, 'Don't waste your breath. Stretch out your head. If you can endure my few sword cuts, I'll lend it to you!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空在芭蕉洞口向铁扇公主借扇，因红孩儿被观音收走一事引发争执，铁扇公主怒斥并以剑相向，孙悟空则提出借扇后可助其子团聚，公主提出以承受几剑为条件才肯借扇。

18 悟空说：‘可以！可以！一定要把扇子借我一用。’公主举起宝剑，连向悟空头上砍了十几下，悟空好像一点感觉没有。公主害了怕，回头就走。悟空说：‘哪里走，快把扇子拿来！’
19 两个在翠云山前，你砍我打，相持到天晚，不分胜负。公主料定斗不过悟空，就取出芭蕉扇晃了一晃，一阵阴风，把悟空扇得飘向天空。
page_text_en:
18 Wukong said: 'Yes! Yes! I must borrow the fan for a moment.' The princess raised her sword and slashed at Wukong's head several times, but Wukong seemed to feel nothing. The princess, frightened, turned and ran. Wukong said: 'Where do you think you're going? Bring me the fan!' 
19 The two fought fiercely before翠云山, striking and blocking, until evening, with no clear winner. The princess, realizing she couldn't defeat Wukong, took out the Banana Fan, waved it once, and a gust of cold wind blew Wukong skyward.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与铁扇公主在翠云山前争执并动手，铁扇公主砍他多刀未伤，后用芭蕉扇将他扇飞。

20 那悟空飘飘荡荡，左沉不能着地，右坠落不下来，像风吹树叶一样，滚了一夜，直到天明，才落在一座山上。
21 他用双手抱住一块峰石，看了很久，才认出这是小须弥山。他自语说：‘这妇人真是厉害！’心想：这一下不知把我扇了几万里，我须下山问个消息，也好找旧路回去见师父。
page_text_en:
20 Wukong floated aimlessly, unable to sink to the ground on the left or fall down on the right, like a leaf blown by the wind, rolling for an entire night until dawn, when he finally landed on a mountain.
21 He clutched a peak rock with both hands, looked for a long time, and finally recognized it as Mount Xiaoxuimi. He muttered to himself, 'This woman is truly formidable!' He thought: 'I don't know how many miles she just blew me away. I must go down the mountain to find out what's happening, and also to find my way back to see my master.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空被铁扇公主用芭蕉扇扇飞后，在空中飘荡一夜，最终落在小须弥山，他认出地点后决定下山打听消息并返回找师父。

22 正在思索，忽听钟声响亮，一看是个熟地方，就急忙下山，直奔禅院。灵吉菩萨笑着说：‘大圣去西天不多几日，怎的就回来了？’悟空叹了口气，把刚才的事情一五一十地说了一遍。
23 灵吉菩萨说：‘注定唐僧能到西天取经，我这里有一粒定风丹，送给你，管叫那扇扇你不动。’悟空感激不尽。灵吉就将那粒定风丹，用针线给悟空缝在衣领里边。
page_text_en:
22 While pondering, he suddenly heard the bell ring loudly. Seeing it was a familiar place, he hurried down the mountain and rushed to the monastery. Lingji Bodhisattva smiled and said, 'Great Sage, you've been to the Western Heaven for only a few days. How come you're back already?' Wukong sighed and told him everything that had just happened, in full detail.
23 Lingji Bodhisattva said, 'It is destined that Master Tang will reach the Western Heaven to obtain the scriptures. I have a pill of wind-stillness here. I'll give it to you; it will ensure that the fan cannot blow you away.' Wukong was deeply grateful. Lingji then took the pill of wind-stillness and sewed it into Wukong's collar with a needle and thread.
summary_zh: 孙悟空被铁扇公主扇飞后，落在小须弥山，遇到灵吉菩萨。他向菩萨说明借扇失败的经过，菩萨赠予他一粒定风丹，并将其缝在衣领里，以抵御芭蕉扇的风力。

25 铁扇公主手提宝剑，心里暗说：‘我这次出去扇他两三扇，叫他找不着归路！’出了洞门，什么话没说，举剑就向悟空砍来。悟空顾不及说话，提起铁棒迎击，两个又打起来。

The princess, upon hearing that Wukong had returned, thought to herself: 'This rascal is truly capable. I can fan him away 84,000 li with one blow. How did he come back again?'
25 Princess Iron Fan held her magic sword and thought to herself, 'This time I'll fan him two or three times and make him lose his way back!' She stepped out of the cave without saying a word, raised her sword, and charged at Wukong. Wukong, not having time to speak, raised his iron staff to meet her, and the two began fighting again.

27 公主有些发慌，收了宝贝，逃回洞中，把门儿紧紧关上。她到了房中，坐到椅子上喘气不止，连忙喊：‘快泡茶来，渴死我了！’

Wukong didn't move at all, and smiled, saying: 'This time is different from last time. Go ahead and fan. If Old Sun moves, he's not a real man!' The princess waved the fan twice more, but Wukong remained completely still.

summary_zh: 孙悟空追到芭蕉洞口，见门关紧无法进入，便化作蚊虫钻入洞内；他见铁扇公主喝茶，便落在茶杯的茶棍上，被公主一口吞下肚中。

31 The princess called for the fan and said: 'Come out quickly!' Before she could finish speaking, Wukong had already flown out of her mouth, landed on the fan, and resumed his original form. Holding the fan, he said: 'Thank you, Princess. I'm off!'

33 师徒四人，辞别老头儿，向西行走。约走出四十里远，渐渐热气蒸人。沙僧、八戒都叫受不了。马也因地热停不住脚步，走得更快。

33 The four disciples bid farewell to the old man and walked westward. After traveling about forty li, the heat became stifling. Sha Wujing and Zhu Bajie both cried out that they couldn't stand it. The horse, too, couldn't stop its steps due to the heat and walked even faster.

35 悟空急忙回身便跑，到了唐僧跟前喊道：‘快回去，快回去！火来了，火来了！’唐僧慌忙上了马，急急往回跑，约有二十里远，才停下来。
page_text_en:
34 Wukong said, 'Master, please dismount. Let me go ahead and fan out the flames. Once it rains and cools down, we can continue!' Saying that, he walked forward a bit, fanned once, and the mountain burst into roaring flames. Fanning again made the fire even fiercer. With a third fan, the flames rose thousands of feet high, nearly burning his own body.
35 Wukong hurriedly turned and ran back. When he reached the Master, he shouted, 'Go back, go back! The fire is coming, the fire is coming!' The Master hastily mounted his horse and rushed back, running about twenty li before finally stopping.
summary_zh: 孙悟空用芭蕉扇扇火，结果火势反而更旺，险些烧到自己；他急忙跑回，告知唐僧火势凶猛，唐僧慌忙骑马逃回二十里远才停下。

斋饭再说。’
37 他们一看，只见一个老人，身后带领一个童子，那
童子捧了一锅黄米饭，老人道：‘我是火焰山土地，知大圣

page_text_en:
36 Wukong explained the situation and sighed, saying, 'I've been tricked by that female demon!' 
Everyone was worried, when suddenly someone called out, 'Great Sage, don't worry. Let's eat some vegetarian food first.' 
37 They looked and saw an old man, followed by a boy. The boy carried a pot of yellow rice. The old man said, 'I am the local spirit of Flame Mountain. I know the Great Sage is protecting the holy monk and cannot proceed, so I've come to bring food to relieve your hunger.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空向唐僧等人说明被铁扇公主骗了，众人发愁时有人提议先吃饭；随后火焰山土地带着童子送来黄米饭，表示关心并提供食物充饥。

38 悟空说：‘吃饭是小事，怎样才能灭火过山？’土地说：‘不难，只要借得铁扇公主的扇子一用就可。’悟空把丢在路旁的扇子给他看，土地笑着说：‘这扇子不是真的，你被她哄了。’
39 土地又说：‘你只要找到铁扇公主的丈夫牛魔王，向他去借就行。他娶了万年狐王的女儿玉面公主为妾，已两年不和铁扇公主住一起了。他现住积雷山摩云洞，离此约三千里。’悟空辞别师父，腾空去了。
page_text_en:
38 Wukong said: 'Eating is a small matter, but how can we put out the fire and cross the mountain?' The Land God said: 'It's not difficult, just borrow the fan of Princess Iron Fan and use it.' Wukong showed him the fan he had dropped by the roadside. The Land God laughed and said: 'This fan is not real; you've been tricked by her.'
39 The Land God continued: 'You just need to find Princess Iron Fan's husband, Bull Demon King, and borrow it from him. He married the daughter of the Ten-Thousand-Year Fox King, Princess Yu Mian, as his concubine, and hasn't lived with Princess Iron Fan for two years. He now resides in Moyun Cave on Jilei Mountain, about three thousand li away.' Wukong bid farewell to his master and flew away.
summary_zh: 孙悟空向土地神询问如何灭火过山，得知所借的扇子是假的，被铁扇公主骗了；土地神建议他去找铁扇公主的丈夫牛魔王借真扇，并告知牛魔王的住处；孙悟空辞别师父，腾空而去寻找牛魔王。

40 到了积雷山，见一美貌女子迎面而来。悟空忙上前施礼探问。这女子见悟空长得怕人，扭身就走。悟空拦住说：“摩云洞在哪里？可有个牛魔王住在那里？”那女子说：“问他怎的？”悟空假说是铁扇公主派他请牛王的。
41 那女子一听，醋意大发，说：“那贱人好不知足，自牛王到我家，每年不知要送她多少东西，现在又来请他？”悟空一听，知道她就是玉面公主，故意举棒吓她说：“你这贱妇恋住牛王不放，还骂别人。”
page_text_en:
40 Arrived at Jilei Mountain, he saw a beautiful woman coming towards him. Wukong hurried forward to greet and inquire. The woman, seeing Wukong's frightening appearance, turned and ran away. Wukong blocked her and asked, "Where is Moyun Cave? Is there a Bull Demon King living there?" The woman replied, "Why are you asking about him?" Wukong lied, saying he was sent by Princess Iron Fan to invite the Bull King.
41 The woman, upon hearing this, became furious with jealousy and said, "That wench is never satisfied. Since the Bull King came to my home, I've had to give her countless gifts every year, and now she wants to invite him again?" Wukong, upon hearing this, realized she was Princess Yu Mian, and deliberately raised his staff to intimidate her, saying, "You wench, clinging to the Bull King and refusing to let go, yet you still insult others."
summary_zh: 孙悟空来到积雷山，遇见玉面公主，谎称受铁扇公主之托请牛魔王，引起玉面公主嫉妒，孙悟空识破其身份后故意举棒吓唬她。

43 那女子进得洞去，和牛魔王哭闹：‘你害得我好苦，连个臭娘们都不敢得罪。刚才我正在洞外散步，碰见个毛脸雷公嘴的和尚，他说是奉了铁扇公主之命前来请你，被我说了两句，他举棒就要打我！’

43 The woman entered the cave and cried out to the Bull Demon King: 'You've made me suffer so much, I can't even stand up to a lowly woman! Just now, while I was walking outside the cave, I met a monk with a hairy face and a thunderous mouth. He said he came to invite you on behalf of Princess Iron Fan. After I spoke to him a few words, he raised his staff and was about to strike me!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空跟随玉面公主来到摩云洞，被她关在门外；玉面公主进洞后向牛魔王哭诉，称孙悟空冒充铁扇公主之命前来请牛魔王，自己被其威胁要打，以此挑拨牛魔王与孙悟空的关系。

44 牛王说：‘我家中连个三尺孩童都没有，哪来的雷公嘴的男子？这许是哪来的妖怪，或许是来访问我的客人，待我出去看看再说。’说罢便披挂起来，手提一根混铁棍，气冲冲地走出门外。
45 他高声喊道：‘是谁在这儿胡闹！’悟空忙上前行礼。牛王道：‘你这猴孙，前者你害了我儿，正在恼你，今又胆敢调戏我爱妾！’悟空陪礼道：‘刚才不知是嫂嫂，因她骂了我几句，小弟一时粗鲁，惊了嫂嫂，还请原谅！’牛王道：‘既是这样，暂饶你这次。’
page_text_en:
44 The Bull King said: 'I don't even have a child three feet tall in my house—where could this man with a thunderbolt mouth come from? Perhaps he's a monster, or maybe a guest visiting me. I'll go out and take a look first.' Saying that, he put on his armor, grabbed a mixed-iron staff, and stormed out the door.
45 He shouted loudly: 'Who's making a ruckus here!' Wukong hurried forward to bow. The Bull King said: 'You monkey brat! Earlier you harmed my son, and I was already angry with you. Now you dare to flirt with my beloved concubine!' Wukong apologized: 'I didn't know she was my sister-in-law. She scolded me a few times, and I was rude in my haste. I startled her—please forgive me!' The Bull King said: 'If that's the case, I'll let you off this time.'
summary_zh: 牛魔王因玉面公主的挑拨而出门查看，见到孙悟空后怒斥其调戏爱妾，孙悟空连忙赔礼，牛魔王最终暂且饶恕了他。

47 牛王一听大怒：‘想必你对我妻无礼，因此她不肯借你，又来找我；到了这里又调戏我爱妾，我哪有扇子借给你用！泼猴先吃我一棍！’说着，举起混铁棍就打。悟空眼快手快，立刻拿起金箍棒相迎。

You're a brave man, wait for me to return and we'll fight again!'

I'm going to a friend's house to drink wine.' He mounted the 'Water-Avoiding Golden-Eyed Beast', rode on clouds, and rushed northwest.

50 悟空心中暗想道：我且跟他前去，看个究竟。不多时到了一座山中，牛王却不见了，只见一个深潭，边上有一座石碑，上刻：“乱石山碧波潭”。
51 悟空想：这家伙一定下水去了！我老孙也下水看看。摇身一变，变了一个大螃蟹，钻进了潭底，忽见一座牌楼，楼下拴着避水金睛兽。
page_text_en:
50 Wukong thought to himself: I'll follow him and see what's going on. After a while, he arrived at a mountain, but the Bull King was nowhere to be seen. He only saw a deep pool, with a stone tablet beside it inscribed with the words: 'Lushan Mountain, Bibo Pool'.
51 Wukong thought: That fellow must have gone underwater! I, Old Sun, will go down and take a look. He transformed himself, becoming a big crab, and dived to the bottom of the pool. Suddenly, he saw a pavilion, with the Water-avoiding Golden-Eyed Beast tied beneath it.
summary_zh: 孙悟空跟随牛魔王的踪迹来到乱石山碧波潭，发现牛王不见踪影，便化身为大螃蟹潜入水底，发现一座牌楼和被拴住的避水金睛兽。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》
title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan
source_file: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》（6-10岁）.pdf

52 悟空爬了进去，只见大厅之中，音乐正奏得起劲，上面坐着牛王，左右有三四个蛟精，前面坐着老龙精，两边坐的龙子、龙孙、龙婆、龙女，大家正在举杯欢饮。
53 悟空想：等他席散了，也不一定借扇给我，何不偷走他的金睛兽，变作牛王模样去铁扇公主那里骗取扇子？主意拿定，骑上金睛兽，出水而去。
page_text_en:
52 Wukong crawled in and saw that in the great hall, music was playing vigorously. The Bull King sat above, with three or four蛟 spirits on either side, the Old Dragon King seated in front, and dragon sons, dragon grandsons, dragon aunts, and dragon daughters seated on both sides, all raising their cups in celebration.
53 Wukong thought: After the feast ends, he may not lend me the fan. Why not steal his Golden-Eyed Beast, transform into the Bull King's likeness, and go to Princess Iron Fan to trick the fan? Having made up his mind, he mounted the Golden-Eyed Beast and rode out of the water.
summary_zh: 孙悟空潜入龙王寿宴大厅，见牛魔王与众龙族正在宴饮；随后他决定偷走牛魔王的避水金睛兽，化身为牛魔王去骗取芭蕉扇，于是骑兽出水而去。

title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan

54 悟空来到了芭蕉洞。心想这次我要处处小心，只要取得扇子就好。叫开了门，女童一看是牛王回来，赶紧进去向公主报告。
55 铁扇公主将悟空迎到房里，以为真是丈夫，含怒说道：“你有了小狐狸精，还有心到这里来？”悟空连忙说：“糟糠之妻难舍，请贤妻息怒。”
page_text_en:
54 Wukong arrived at the Banana Cave. He thought, 'This time I must be careful everywhere; as long as I get the fan, it will be fine.' He called the door open. The girl servant, seeing that it was the Bull King returning, hurried inside to report to the princess.
55 The Princess of the Iron Fan welcomed Wukong into the room, thinking he was truly her husband. She said angrily, 'You have a little fox spirit, and yet you still have the heart to come here?' Wukong hurriedly replied, 'A wife of humble beginnings is hard to forsake. Please, my dear wife, calm your anger.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空化身为牛魔王，来到芭蕉洞，被铁扇公主误认为丈夫，铁扇公主因误会而责问，孙悟空连忙赔礼，谎称自己是糟糠之妻难舍。

title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan
source_file: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》（6-10岁）.pdf

56 公主说：‘我这两年没有你也过了，给我滚出去！’这时小女童在那里给悟空递眼色，叫他跪下陪罪，悟空想：为了借扇，我只好委屈一下。连忙跪倒说：‘都是我的不是，我给你跪下了。’
57 公主经他这一跪，怒气已散，说：‘谁稀罕你跪，起来吧！’停了一下说：‘我要只恶猴，给我下酒吃！’悟空一听，暗吃一惊，说：‘这也不难，待我陪夫人痛饮一番，前去捉猴就是。’立刻摆起酒席痛饮起来。
page_text_en:
56 The princess said, 'I've gotten along fine without you for these two years. Get out!' At that moment, the little maid gave a signal to Wukong, telling him to kneel and apologize. Wukong thought: For the sake of borrowing the fan, I'll have to endure this humiliation. He quickly knelt down and said, 'It's all my fault. I'm kneeling before you.'
57 The princess, after seeing him kneel, calmed down and said, 'Who cares if you kneel? Get up!' Then she paused and said, 'I want a vicious monkey, to be served as a drink!' Wukong, upon hearing this, was secretly startled and replied, 'That's not difficult. Let me drink with you, then I'll go catch a monkey.' He immediately set up a feast and began drinking heartily.
summary_zh: 孙悟空化身为牛魔王，来到芭蕉洞，被铁扇公主误认为丈夫。铁扇公主起初愤怒，后因孙悟空下跪赔罪而怒气渐消，但提出要吃猴肉下酒，孙悟空答应陪她饮酒后去捉猴。

title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan

58 饮酒间，公主把悟空怎样借扇，怎样把他扇走，后来又怎样不得已把扇借给他，从头到尾说了一遍。悟空故作惊讶：‘怎么？你把镇山宝物随便被人拿去，真气死我了。’公主笑着说：‘那是假扇，真扇在我怀中呢！’
59 悟空说：‘那就好了。我们痛饮吧！’两人喝了一阵，公主有几分醉意说：‘你说给我捉只恶猴下酒，快去给我捉来！’悟空说：‘不难不难，悟空会定身法，我专门有破身法，快把宝扇给我，我马上把他捉来。’
page_text_en:
58 While drinking, the princess recounted to Wukong how he had borrowed the fan, how she had fanned him away, and how she had reluctantly lent it to him, telling the whole story from beginning to end. Wukong feigned surprise: 'How? You let someone just take away our mountain's treasure? That really angers me!' The princess smiled and said: 'That was a fake fan. The real one is in my bosom!' 
59 Wukong said: 'That's great. Let's drink heartily!' After drinking for a while, the princess, slightly drunk, said: 'You said you'd catch a wicked monkey for me to eat with wine. Go catch him for me now!' Wukong replied: 'Not difficult at all. I know the immobilization technique, and I have a special counter-technique. Give me the treasure fan quickly, and I'll catch him right away.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空化身为牛魔王，在芭蕉洞与铁扇公主饮酒，公主讲述借扇经过并谎称真扇在怀，孙悟空为取真扇，答应为她捉拿猴子下酒。

60 公主从怀中取出宝扇，递给悟空，悟空向怀中一揣，变了原形，向公主说：‘谢谢嫂子！’一转眼不见了。
61 公主一见是孙悟空，着急地说：‘大事不好，芭蕉扇被孙悟空骗去了！’正在着急，牛魔王赶来。原来筵席散后，他找不见金睛兽，料想必是孙悟空偷走，因此，就急忙赶了来。
page_text_en:
60 The princess took the magic fan from her bosom and handed it to Wukong. Wukong tucked it into his bosom, transformed back to his original form, and said to the princess, 'Thank you, sister-in-law!' Then he vanished in an instant.
61 The princess, seeing it was Sun Wukong, anxiously said, 'Oh no! The Banana Fan has been tricked away by Sun Wukong!' Just as she was panicking, the Bull Demon King arrived. After the banquet ended, he couldn't find the Golden-Eyed Beast and suspected Sun Wukong had stolen it, so he hurried over.
summary_zh: 孙悟空从铁扇公主处骗得芭蕉扇后化作原形离开，铁扇公主发现被骗后焦急万分，牛魔王闻讯赶来，因丢失避水金睛兽而怀疑孙悟空所为。

模样，骗走了芭蕉扇。’牛王一听急得叫道：‘别说了，快把
你的剑给我，我去追他！’
63 牛王赶上了悟空，心想，倘若孙猴不给我扇子，扇
我一下，要去八万四千里远，我怎吃得消？我不免变作猪
八戒模样，在路上等他，骗了过来就是。摇身一变，变作
八戒模样等在路上。
page_text_en:
62 The princess saw the Bull King and was furious, shouting: 'You old fool, you've been tricked by a little demon! Sun Wukong stole your Golden-Eyed Beast, transformed into your likeness, and tricked away the Banana Fan!' The Bull King, upon hearing this, cried out in panic: 'Stop! Give me your sword, I'll go after him!'
63 The Bull King caught up with Wukong and thought: 'If that monkey doesn't give me the fan, and fans me once, I'll be sent eight hundred thousand li away—how could I endure that? I might as well turn into the form of Zhu Bajie, wait for him on the road, and trick him into coming over. So he transformed himself into Zhu Bajie's form and waited by the roadside.
summary_zh: 铁扇公主向牛魔王揭露孙悟空冒充其骗走芭蕉扇，牛魔王闻言大怒，决定追赶孙悟空；随后他化身为猪八戒，在路上设下计谋准备诱骗孙悟空。

64 悟空正得意地往回走，冷不防遇见八戒，就问：‘二弟在这里干甚？’牛王说：‘师父放心不下，叫我在此等你。’悟空说：‘我变了牛王模样，和铁扇公主做了一场干夫妻，用酒把她灌醉，扇子已骗到手。’
65 牛王说：‘那好极了，快把扇子给我替你拿着，去见师父吧，师父早等急了！’悟空哪里知道是假八戒，就把扇子交给牛王。牛王得了扇子，现了原形说：‘大胆猴头，吃你牛爷一剑！’
page_text_en:
64 Wukong was walking back proudly when he unexpectedly met Bajie and asked, 'What are you doing here, younger brother?' The Ox King replied, 'Master was worried, so he told me to wait for you here.' Wukong said, 'I transformed into the Ox King's appearance, had a fake marriage with Princess Iron Fan, got her drunk with wine, and have already tricked the fan away.'
65 The Ox King said, 'That's wonderful! Quickly give me the fan to hold for you. Go see Master; he's been waiting anxiously!' Wukong, not knowing it was a fake Bajie, handed the fan over to the Ox King. The Ox King, having obtained the fan, revealed his true form and said, 'You bold monkey, take this sword from your Ox King!'
summary_zh: 孙悟空得意地返回途中，遇见化身为猪八戒的牛魔王，误以为是真八戒，便将骗得的芭蕉扇交出；牛魔王得扇后现出原形，举剑欲斩孙悟空。

帮他一下。倘若扇子到手，快拿来也好早日过山。”
page_text_en:
66 Wukong, seeing he had been deceived by the Bull King, immediately became furious, raised his iron staff, and swung it toward the Bull King.
67 At this moment, Tang Sanzang, waiting impatiently along the way, said to Zhu Bajie: 
"Wukong has been gone all day and hasn't returned. He must be fighting that old bull. Go help him quickly. If you get the fan, bring it back soon so we can cross the mountain early."
summary_zh: 孙悟空发现被牛魔王骗走芭蕉扇后愤怒反击，而唐僧因等得不耐烦，命猪八戒去帮助孙悟空。

68 八戒扛了铁钯，直奔南方而去。行了一程，看见悟空和牛王正打得不分胜负，八戒把钯一举，高叫一声：‘师兄休息一下，叫瘟牛尝尝猪爷爷铁钯的味道！’说罢，朝着牛王打去。
69 那牛王斗了多时，精力早有些支持不住，哪里还经得起八戒铁钯。斗了一阵就败走了。
page_text_en:
68 Pigsy carried his rake and rushed southward. After a while, he saw Wukong and the Bull King fighting fiercely, neither gaining the upper hand. Pigsy raised his rake and shouted, 'Brother, take a break! Let this pestilential bull taste the flavor of Uncle Pig's iron rake!' Then he charged at the Bull King.
69 The Bull King had fought for a long time and was already running low on energy. How could he withstand Pigsy's iron rake? After a while, he was defeated and fled.
summary_zh: 猪八戒赶来助战，加入孙悟空与牛魔王的战斗，牛魔王因体力不支被猪八戒击败而逃走。

71 牛王一见助手出来，精神抖擞，又加上众妖一齐上前乱砍，八戒抵挡不住，倒拖着钉钯败阵而去；悟空也跳出重围，纵身到云中去了。
page_text_en:
70 Pigsy and Wukong, unwilling to let him go, chased after him. The Bull King could only fight while retreating. After fighting all night, he finally retreated to the entrance of the Muyun Cave on Jilei Mountain. At that moment, the Jade-Faced Princess, who was in the cave worrying about the Bull King, suddenly heard the sounds of weapons outside the cave and led her subordinates out to see what was happening.
71 The Bull King, upon seeing his assistant arrive, became spirited. With the added force of the demons charging forward together, Pigsy could not withstand the attack and retreated, dragging his rake behind him; Wukong also broke out of the encirclement and leaped into the clouds.
summary_zh: 孙悟空与猪八戒追赶牛魔王至积雷山摩云洞口，牛魔王退守洞中。玉面公主闻声率众妖出洞助战，牛魔王士气大振，反攻之下，猪八戒败退，孙悟空跳入云中逃脱。

73 悟空、八戒正在犯愁，心想：老牛这般凶，实在不易把他斗倒，扇子弄不来，我们师徒如何过得火焰山？回头一看沙僧也来了。
page_text_en:
72 The Bull King, having won the battle, led the group of demons into the cave, tightly closed the cave entrance, and wanted to rest for a while.
73 Wukong and Bajie were worried, thinking: This old bull is so fierce; it's really hard to defeat him. Without the fan, how can our master and disciples cross the Flame Mountain? Turning around, they saw Sha Wujing had arrived too.
summary_zh: 牛魔王战胜孙悟空和猪八戒后，带领众妖退回洞中休息；孙悟空和猪八戒则因无法取得芭蕉扇而发愁，此时沙僧也赶到了。

page_text_en:
74 They all arrived at the cave entrance together, wielding spades and rods with clashing sounds, smashing the front gate of Moyun Cave to pieces.
75 At this moment, Bull King and Princess Yumian were discussing the fight with Wukong when a small demon came to report that the front gate had been broken. He couldn't rest and grabbed his iron staff, rushing out to meet them.
summary_zh: 孙悟空和猪八戒等人合力砸毁摩云洞前门，牛魔王与玉面公主正在洞内交谈时，小妖来报前门被毁，牛魔王随即持铁棍出洞迎战。

77 那牛王见进不得洞，就慌忙摇身一变，变作一只天鹅飞向天空，八戒和沙僧一时不见老牛，心正纳闷，悟空说：‘那飞向天空的天鹅就是他的化身，待我上天捉他去。’
page_text_en:
76 Wukong, BaJie, and ShaSeng saw Niuwang come out and attacked him immediately. Niuwang, seeing the unfavorable situation, fought for a while, then tried to retreat back to the cave, but was blocked by ShaSeng.
77 Seeing he couldn't enter the cave, Niuwang hurriedly transformed himself into a swan and flew into the sky. BaJie and ShaSeng, unable to see the old ox, were puzzled. Wukong said, 'That swan flying into the sky is his transformed self. I'll go up and catch him.'
summary_zh: 孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧合力迎战牛魔王，牛魔王见势不妙欲退入洞中，被沙僧拦住；牛魔王变作天鹅飞走，孙悟空识破其化身，决定上天追捕。

78 悟空摇身一变，变作一只海东青，飕地一下，飞入云里，倒飞下来，落在天鹅身上，骑着他的脖子，就啄眼睛。
79 牛王知道是悟空变的，就慌忙变作一只鹰，来啄海东青。悟空又慌忙变了样，牛王也变了样。这样变了五六次，总是老牛变得吃亏。最后，老牛无法，变了原形，一只大白牛，头如峻岭，两只角像两座塔，身有千余丈长。
page_text_en:
78 Wukong transformed himself into a sea eagle, swooped down, flew into the clouds, dived downward, landed on the swan's back, rode on its neck, and pecked at its eyes.
79 The Bull King, realizing it was Wukong in disguise, hastily transformed into an eagle to peck at the sea eagle. Wukong hurriedly changed his form again, and the Bull King changed too. After changing forms five or six times, the old bull always ended up at a disadvantage. Finally, unable to continue, the old bull reverted to his original form—a huge white bull, with a head like a mountain ridge, two horns like two towers, and a body over a thousand zhang long.
summary_zh: 孙悟空变作海东青追击化作天鹅的牛魔王，牛魔王变作鹰反击，双方多次变化形态斗法，最终牛魔王因屡次吃亏而现出原形，化作一只巨大的白牛。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》
title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan
source_file: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
80 悟空也摇身一变，现了原形叫一声“长！”长得身高万丈，头如泰山，口似血池。老牛硬着头，将角来触他，这一下真是山摇地动。
81 两个正在斗得起劲，八戒、沙僧也来了。老牛一看斗不过他们，就往芭蕉洞跑去。
page_text_en:
80 Wukong also transformed, revealing his true form and shouting, “Grow!” He grew to a height of ten thousand feet, his head like Mount Tai, his mouth like a blood pool. The old ox, with head held firm, charged at him with his horns—this single blow truly shook the mountains and the earth.
81 The two were fighting fiercely when Bajie and Sha Wujing arrived. The old ox, seeing he couldn’t defeat them, fled toward Banana Cave.
summary_zh: 孙悟空变回原形与牛魔王激战，牛魔王不敌，见猪八戒和沙僧赶来助战，便逃往芭蕉洞。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》
title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan
source_file: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
82 悟空、八戒、沙僧追到洞口，八戒见洞门紧闭，举起铁钯，把那石壁和门钯倒了半边。
83 老牛正和铁扇公主商量如何抵挡，见这阵势也慌了手脚，忙把宝扇交给公主，要冲出去逃走。
page_text_en:
82 Wukong, Bajie, and Sha僧 chased to the cave entrance. Bajie saw the cave door tightly shut, raised his iron rake, and knocked down half of the stone wall and door.
83 The old bull was discussing with Princess Iron Fan how to resist, but seeing this situation, he became flustered, quickly handed the magic fan to the princess, and prepared to rush out and flee.
summary_zh: 孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧追至洞口，猪八戒砸毁洞门；牛魔王与铁扇公主在洞内商议对策，见势不妙，牛魔王慌忙将宝扇交给铁扇公主后欲逃走。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》
title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan
source_file: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
84 老牛奋力冲出门外，被八戒沙僧围住，老牛左冲右撞，刚要冲出包围，悟空手起棒落，把老牛打倒在洞口。
85 此时哪吒等天神奉旨赶来，收伏了牛王。悟空、八戒、沙僧冲进芭蕉洞。铁扇公主见大势已去，就束手被擒了。
page_text_en:
84 The old bull struggled to charge out of the gate, surrounded by Pigsy and Sandy. The bull charged left and right, just about to break free, when Wukong swung his staff and knocked the bull down at the cave entrance.
85 At this moment, Nezha and other heavenly gods arrived as commanded, subduing the Bull King. Wukong, Pigsy, and Sandy rushed into the Banana Cave. Princess Iron Fan, seeing the situation was lost, surrendered without resistance.
summary_zh: 牛魔王被孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧围困在洞口，最终被孙悟空击倒；随后哪吒等天神赶到，收伏牛魔王，孙悟空等人冲入芭蕉洞，铁扇公主见势不妙束手就擒。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》
title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan
source_file: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
86 悟空、八戒、沙僧擒了铁扇公主来见师父。
87 唐僧对铁扇公主说：‘你若把扇子借给我扇熄火焰，永不发火，让我师徒能到西天取经，饶你不死！’铁扇公主这时已无可奈何，只得把芭蕉扇交给唐僧。
page_text_en:
86 Wukong, Bajie, and Sha僧 captured Princess Iron Fan and brought her to see their master.
87 The monk said to Princess Iron Fan: 'If you lend me the fan to extinguish the flames, I will never be angry again, and let my disciples and I go to the West to fetch the scriptures. I will spare your life!' Princess Iron Fan, now helpless, had no choice but to hand over the Banana Fan to the monk.
summary_zh: 孙悟空、猪八戒和沙僧擒获铁扇公主并带她见唐僧，唐僧以不追究其罪为条件，逼迫铁扇公主交出芭蕉扇。

title_zh: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》
title_en: The Monkey King and the Three Theft of the Banana Fan
source_file: 连环画《西游记22：三盗芭蕉扇》（6-10岁）.pdf
page_text_ocr_zh:
88 悟空从师傅手中拿过了芭蕉扇，就要去扇，铁扇公主说：“要想扇熄这火焰山，只要扇四十九下就行，多不得少不得，多一下就发大水，少一下就不能断火根，日后还会发火。”
89 悟空就依着这言语，对准火焰山连扇四十九下，果然见火焰山头，大雨倾盆，不一刻火焰便熄灭了。
page_text_en:
88 Wukong took the Banana Fan from his master's hand and was about to fan it. Princess Iron Fan said, 'To extinguish this Flame Mountain, you must fan it exactly forty-nine times. Not one more, not one less. One extra fan will cause a flood, and one less will not cut off the fire's root, and it will flare up again later.'
89 Wukong followed her instructions, fanning the Flame Mountain forty-nine times in a row. Sure enough, at the peak of the mountain, it began to pour rain heavily, and in no time, the flames were extinguished.
summary_zh: 铁扇公主向孙悟空说明扇灭火焰山需扇四十九下，多一下会发大水，少一下则火根不断。孙悟空依言扇动四十九下，火焰山果然大雨倾盆，火焰熄灭。
